notes.title: goblinAmerica demo update #2
notes.notes:
I just pushed a patch to the demo. Here are some of the most notable changes:

[list]
[*] Sunscorched wizards in the Undergunk and Moon Crypt emit a low hum.
[*] Wizard projectiles always repel you.
[*] UI reflects that it is impossible to summon God's Finger or begin conversations while airborne.
[*] The golden seal in Virginia demands less.
[*] Some fonts changed.
[*] Songs restart less frequently, especially in healthcare buildings and swamps.
[*] Interaction prompts reflect your preferred controller.
[*] Improved the legibility of flasks.
[*] The Sunship Wheel appears and disappears at normal times.
[/list]

Thank you for reading and playing. More soon. Go get'em.

notes.title: lil demo update for you
notes.notes:
Hey, hope everyone is enjoying Steam Next Fest! It's been great hearing from people having fun with the demo, and I've appreciated all the kind words.

I'm pushing a patch with some minor bugfixes. The two worth noting are:

[list]
[*] Fix for crashing when trying to apply graphics settings on non-DLSS-compatible setups.
[*] Keybind overrides should now correctly persist between game sessions.
[/list]

I'm currently working on some changes (both small and large) that I intend to drop a little later in the week. If you run into any other problems in the meantime, please let me know! 

Also, I've been very impressed by some of the times you guys are putting up. If you take video of a good run or find a cool route, please share it with me—I'd love to see.

go get'em, goblin
